name: personalized-mausam-backend
description: Trusted Backend API for Personalized Mausam Weather Companion

scripts.db:clean: node --input-type=module -e "import mongoose from 'mongoose'; import dotenv from 'dotenv'; dotenv.config(); await mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI, { dbName: process.env.MONGODB_DB_NAME, family: 4 }); const r = await mongoose.connection.db.collection('users').deleteMany({}); console.log('Cleared users:', r.deletedCount); await mongoose.disconnect();"
